project.name: Common Logging
project.description: Single physical source of the shared Logback base (logback-includes/logging-base.xml) plus the logstash JSON encoder it requires. Included by every service and infra module so the logging config exists in exactly one place (no per-service mirrored copies / drift). Intentionally dependency-light: no Spring auto-config, gRPC, Kafka or Redis - only the logback encoder needed to parse the base.
